titleEn: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses
title: 反转每对括号间的子串
summary: 从内到外反转每对匹配括号中的字符串，最终删除所有括号并返回结果。
insight: 遇左括号时把外层已构造字符串压栈并开始新片段；遇右括号时反转当前内层片段，再接到弹出的外层后方，天然按嵌套顺序处理。
pitfalls: 括号保证匹配且不出现在结果中
反转发生在每一层闭合时
普通字符直接追加到当前片段

solutions.title: 构造器栈嵌套反转
solutions.idea: 用栈保存每层左括号之前的外部前缀。
steps: 遇 (：压入 current 并新建空 current；遇 )：反转 current，弹出 outer 并令 current=outer+current
普通字母追加 current，扫描结束返回 current

code.java: class Solution { public String reverseParentheses(String s){Deque<StringBuilder> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();StringBuilder current=new StringBuilder();for(char ch:s.toCharArray())if(ch=='('){stack.push(current);current=new StringBuilder();}else if(ch==')'){current.reverse();StringBuilder outer=stack.pop();outer.append(current);current=outer;}else current.append(ch);return current.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun reverseParentheses(s:String):String{val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<StringBuilder>();var current=StringBuilder();for(ch in s)if(ch=='('){stack.push(current);current=StringBuilder()}else if(ch==')'){current.reverse();val outer=stack.pop();outer.append(current);current=outer}else current.append(ch);return current.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string reverseParentheses(string s){stack<string> saved;string current;for(char ch:s)if(ch=='('){saved.push(current);current.clear();}else if(ch==')'){reverse(current.begin(),current.end());current=saved.top()+current;saved.pop();}else current+=ch;return current;} };
